specification.title: PostgreSQL ends runner A's idle sessions while A is inside the migration
steps: Wait until one of A's sessions has ended, or 4 s have passed.
Runner B applies { m1 }. For the bound, B may exit, reach the gate, or stay blocked on the framework's own coordination.
Release K. A and B finish within the deadline. Runner C applies { m1 }.
Checkpoint `after-end`, as soon as the last runner has returned: the runner records the state at report time.

invariants.statement: After every runner has finished, the migration's marker count is 1 and history holds one entry for it.

If any single session of runner A ends while A is inside the migration, either A's execution of it does not commit, or no other runner executes it before A finishes: its marker count is 1. Judged only when the session actually ended; otherwise the case is INCONCLUSIVE.
No runner starts executing the migration while another runner's execution of it is still live (its session still inside the migration): two live sessions inside it at once is a violation.

execution.description: Drizzle's db.transaction(callback) on a pg.Pool (the driver default when given a connection string). The pool max is the case's pool_max. No command-tag check, no connection discard, no extra rollback, and no 'error' listener on pooled clients.
execution.form: migrate() from drizzle-orm/node-postgres/migrator, migrationsSchema public and migrationsTable drizzle_migrations, so the runner can count that identifier. The generated SQL inserts the marker and waits on pg_advisory_xact_lock inside the migrator transaction. A DrizzleQueryError is recorded with its class, the SQLSTATE of its cause, and a message the adapter composes from the failed statement and the cause's message.

server.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

knowledge: idle_session_timeout ends a session that is idle outside a transaction. A session busy inside the migration's transaction is not idle, so the setting does not end that session.

api_outcome.contract: drizzle-orm PgDialect.migrate (pg-core/dialect.js) creates the history table, reads the latest created_at, then runs every pending migration's statements and the history insert inside one session.transaction. There is no advisory lock. The migrator has no reversal.
